info.title: Mockingbird Fleet Cloud API
info.description:
Control plane for hosted Mockingbird fleets: organizations, members, projects, fleets, emulators and API keys. The dashboard is a client of this API and nothing else.

Authenticate with `Authorization: Bearer <key>`. A personal token (`mbf_u_…`) acts as its user; an organization key (`mbf_o_…`) or project key (`mbf_p_…`) acts with its role inside that organization or project.
